title: Conditional full-Q witness positivity and stationarity-limit transfer
purpose: Record Lean-checked consequences needed after a source-owned full-Q sector law is supplied: a nonnegative finite mixture is strictly positive when one witness sector has positive weight and positive component value, and a generator-expectation sequence converges to zero under an explicit absolute-error bound.

lean.scope: Abstract finite-sector mixture and real sequence only. A positive witness weight and component value are explicit hypotheses; no PAH sector law or generator is defined.

assumptions: The sector index type is finite.
All component expectations for the selected observable are nonnegative.
One selected witness sector has strictly positive weight and strictly positive component expectation.
The finite generator expectation has an absolute error bound tending to zero, or is eventually zero.
theorem_contract.conclusion: The selected finite mixture is strictly positive, and a generator-expectation sequence converges to zero under the supplied error hypothesis.
not_supplied: No source-owned cross-Q weights w_(n,R,Q) or projective kernel.
No identification of an R-488 witness sector with a positive asymptotic weight.
No PAH-specific generator error formula, common topology or stationarity passage.
No full-Q Gibbs state or omega is constructed.

non_claims: This packet does not choose or fit a sector-weight law and does not instantiate mu_(n,R) or omega.
It does not prove that the R-488 witness receives positive weight, nor that its component expectation survives a projective limit.
It does not prove omega(L f)=0 for PAH data; it only supplies the conditional error-to-zero implication.
No physical Pre-A, spacetime, QFT, gravity, Yang--Mills, mass-gap, cosmological or TOE conclusion follows.
